sentences.text: Considering the nature of the case and the allegations against him and the fact that all prosecution witnesses have been examined and even the statement of the petitioner under Section 313 of the Code of Criminal Procedure have been recorded.
Under these circumstances, we do not think a case of bail is made out at this stage.
The present petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
